review_notice: Draft for owner review. Nothing in this package is clinically approved, establishes an admission threshold, or encodes law. Do not activate.

source_classification.drafting_lead: BN-05 PsychiatricHospitalization is an incomplete, inference-disabled drafting lead, not an approved mapping.

question_enumeration.specific_question: For an adult registration encounter, given currently assessed safety and course factors, what is the posterior distribution over near-term care-setting review prompts (routine outpatient review vs urgent same-day review vs emergency immediate assessment), to structure physician review of disposition?
question_enumeration.intended_setting: General adult outpatient / initial psychiatric evaluation as described in STATEMENT-01 (Table 1 assessment context). Not the emergency department, not a medical inpatient unit. Local setting confirmation requested.
question_enumeration.proposed_time_horizon: 7 days from the registration encounter for urgent/emergency review need. Owner to confirm 7 vs 30 days (Q1).

output_meanings.routine_outpatient_review: Review prompt: routine outpatient follow-up appears sufficient on recorded inputs alone. Not a discharge, not a risk clearance.
output_meanings.urgent_same_day_review: Review prompt: arrange same-day senior/clinical review and safety planning; evaluate supervised, partial-hospital, or inpatient evaluation settings. Not an admission order.
output_meanings.emergency_immediate_assessment: Review prompt: seek immediate senior/emergency evaluation now per local emergency protocol. Not an admission order and not an involuntary-care determination (R3 separate).

question_enumeration.applicability: All registration encounters (encounter.kind == registration). No clinical gate; partial/conflicting required inputs yield needs_clarification and stop later questions.

source_comparison.no_matching_executable_network: No BN corresponds to R1 hospitalization. BN-05 PsychiatricHospitalization is a follow-up outcome node inside a different (also draft, inference-disabled) network, not a registration disposition question; it was used only as a terminology lead for PriorCourse and its local-modeling warning is preserved.
source_comparison.guideline_gives_no_cutoff: STATEMENT-01/02/03 describe what to assess and plan, not when to admit. No source states an admission law, a universal risk cutoff, or a score-to-disposition rule. This draft therefore proposes review prompts plus a deterministic urgent flag from recorded inputs, never an automatic disposition.
source_comparison.assessment_reuse: C-SSRS meanings (ideation levels, behavior categories, no composite score) are reused as reviewed; PANSS totals/bands and diagnosis thresholds are deliberately NOT converted into disposition gates.
source_comparison.history_reuse: PriorCourse reuses the awaiting_review history draft fields as candidates; admission type, causes, and lookback remain unresolved (Q5).

nodes: HospitalizationReview (3 states; parents in order SuicidalConcern, AggressionConcern, SupportSupervision, PriorCourse)
graph_decision.why_this_shape: One flat review node over four currently-or-proposably collected factors. No latent nodes, no posterior chaining into other questions, all discrete nature nodes for the v1 execution profile. Demographics, substance detail, medical acuity, and PANSS/diagnosis specifics are explicitly excluded from v0.1 to keep the first draft reviewable; owner decides additions (Q8).
graph_decision.double_counting_rationale_for_review: Each input is proposed as usage=both (CPT-estimation context + hard observation). Rationale for review: conditioning once in Bayes rule is a single update, not double counting; the LLM conditions table estimates on the patient's context while inference instantiates the same observed states as evidence. Owner to accept or restrict to observation-only.

reference_table_provenance.status: synthetic structural placeholder only; zero clinical validity
reference_table_provenance.rule: Root references illustrative (e.g., SuicidalConcern [0.60,0.20,0.10,0.10]); child rows from a documented urgency-score lookup over per-node weights (SuicidalConcern absent 0 / ideation_without_plan 1 / plan_intent_or_recent_behavior 2 / unknown 1; AggressionConcern absent 0 / present 2 / unknown 1; SupportSupervision adequate 0 / limited 1 / unknown 1; PriorCourse no_prior 0 / prior 1 / unknown 1; total-to-distribution: <=1 [0.85,0.12,0.03], 2 [0.60,0.30,0.10], 3 [0.35,0.45,0.20], 4 [0.15,0.50,0.35], >=5 [0.05,0.35,0.60]). Lookup exists only to give the validator/inference harness complete, normalized, correctly ordered tables. Never present these as patient estimates.
reference_table_provenance.forbidden: No empirical probabilities were manufactured; no guideline evidence rating was converted into a probability.
